facts.fact: The draft 2027 finance bill's presentation note cites national models GemMaroc (language) and IsMa (automatic transcription) for darija, Amazigh and Arabic, linked to an R&D lab set up with Mistral AI.

The draft 2027 finance bill's presentation note, presented to Parliament on 2026-10-23, provides for a Cloud First circular, the Jazari-Root sovereign data centre in Rabat (50 MW, 2027-2029) for the state's strategic data, and a national sovereign cloud for Moroccans' data.
